strings.groups.0.name: Motorcycles, mopeds, tricycles and quad bikes
strings.groups.0.note: Questions labelled A. The practical test for A and A1 is taken on a two-wheeled motorcycle with its own exercises; for B1, on a tricycle or quad bike in the category B zones. A category A licence already includes A1 and B1 (with a motorcycle-style seating position); a category B licence has included A1 and B1 since 05.04.2025.
strings.groups.1.name: Passenger cars and passenger cars with a trailer
strings.groups.1.note: Questions labelled B and general questions. You can obtain BE no earlier than 12 months after B; the practical test on a BE vehicle combination is taken separately.
strings.groups.2.name: Trucks and road trains
strings.groups.2.note: Questions labelled C. C1 - from 18; C - from 21 with 3 years of experience, including 1 year on C1. A category C licence includes C1; CE includes C1E.
strings.groups.3.name: Buses and buses with a trailer
strings.groups.3.note: Questions labelled D. D1 - from 21 with 3 years of experience, including 1 year on C1; D - from 23 with 3 years of experience, including 1 year on D1. An articulated bus falls under category DE.
strings.groups.4.name: Tram and trolleybus
strings.groups.4.note: Questions labelled T. Tm - from 21; Tb - from 23 with 3 years of experience, including 1 year on D1. The practical test is conducted by a training organisation, not at a test ground.
strings.categories.0.name: Subcategory A1: light motorcycles, tricycles, quad bikes and mopeds
strings.categories.0.vehicles: Motorcycles, tricycles and quad bikes with a maximum design speed of more than 50 km/h, an internal combustion engine displacement of not more than 125 cm³ and a maximum power of not more than 11 kW, and also all mopeds ⟦1⟧. Under the Rules, a moped is a two- or three-wheeled vehicle with an internal combustion engine of up to 50 cm³ or an electric motor and a design speed of not more than 50 km/h (para. 2(50) of the Rules). From 25.08.2026, bicycles with an engine are treated as mopeds (Law No. 326-VIII).
strings.categories.0.age: 16 years (Road Traffic Act, art. 74(2)); a moped may be driven from the age of 16 (para. 165 of the Rules)
strings.categories.0.theory: General theory test at a specialised PSC (Public Service Centre): 40 questions, 40 minutes, at least 32 correct answers required, language - Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦2⟧. If you are opening several categories at once, you take the theory test only once ⟦3⟧. Whether the set of questions differs by category is not officially confirmed (see notes).
strings.categories.0.practical.where: Automated test ground of the State Corporation “Government for Citizens” (specialised PSC), assessed by an automatic system ⟦4⟧. Theory first, then the practical test ⟦5⟧.
strings.categories.0.practical.notes.0: The Examination Rules ⟦7⟧ describe only the zone markings for A and A1: control lines are yellow marking 1.4, the edges of the surface are white marking 1.2, and the “Start”, “Stop” and “Finish” lines are white strips 0.4 m wide. The Examination Rules do not list the names of the exercises.
strings.categories.0.practical.notes.1: The list of exercises is taken from the test ground method (24pdd.kz, version of 21.06.2026, Almaty test ground); it also notes that “Acceleration and braking”, “Slalom” and “Low-speed riding” have been removed. Informburo (2023) described a different list of 10 exercises; it matches neither the Examination Rules nor the 2026 method. Check the layout of your own test ground.
strings.categories.0.practical.notes.2: Under the method: putting a foot down on the surface - 100 penalty points, a wheel running over a control line - 25, the engine stalling - 25; a “fail” is given when the total is more than 99 points.
strings.categories.0.practical.notes.3: The right to A1 is also confirmed by category A and B licences (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8), in the version in force since 05.04.2025): with them you do not need to take A1 separately.

strings.categories.11.practical.notes.0: For BE, CE, C1E, DE and D1E, para. 39 of the Examination Rules describes only the zone markings: control lines 1.4, yellow broken lines marking the start and end of exercises (width 0.10 m, dash 0.15 m, gap 0.10 m), white “Start” and “Finish” lines 0.4 m wide, lettering 1 m from the lines.

strings.autodrom.A.0.name: Start (motorcycle)
strings.autodrom.A.0.goal: Get ready before the command and move off without delay with the lights and the left indicator on.
strings.autodrom.A.0.how.0: Before the command, put on and fasten the motorcycle helmet and adjust the rear-view mirrors.
strings.autodrom.A.0.how.1: Take your place on the motorcycle in the pre-start zone, start the engine and switch on the dipped headlight.
strings.autodrom.A.0.how.2: Switch on the left direction indicator.
strings.autodrom.A.0.how.3: On the “Start” command, begin moving within 20 seconds and cross the “Start” line with the left indicator on.
strings.autodrom.A.0.how.4: Switch off the indicator before the line marking the end of the exercise.
strings.autodrom.A.0.penalties.0: Did not start moving within 30 seconds after the “Start” command - 100 points, test failed.
strings.autodrom.A.0.penalties.1: Did not start moving within 20 seconds - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.0.penalties.2: Crossed the “Start” line with the left indicator off - 10 points.
strings.autodrom.A.0.penalties.3: Crossed the “Start” line with the dipped headlight off - 10 points.
strings.autodrom.A.0.tip: Check your helmet, dipped headlight and left indicator before the command: these are the most frustrating penalties.
strings.autodrom.A.1.name: Gauge corridor
strings.autodrom.A.1.goal: Ride through the narrow corridor without touching the control lines with your wheels or putting a foot down on the area.
strings.autodrom.A.1.how.0: Enter the corridor straight, along its centre.
strings.autodrom.A.1.how.1: Keep a low, steady speed: at too low a speed the motorcycle loses balance.
strings.autodrom.A.1.how.2: Look ahead, at the exit of the corridor, not at the front wheel.
strings.autodrom.A.1.how.3: Keep your feet on the footrests until the end of the exercise.
strings.autodrom.A.1.penalties.0: Touched the surface of the area with a foot - 100 points.
strings.autodrom.A.1.penalties.1: Ran a wheel over a control line - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.1.tip: One touch with a foot is already a failure, so it is better to ride a little faster but with confidence than to crawl and struggle to balance.
strings.autodrom.A.2.name: Gauge semicircle
strings.autodrom.A.2.goal: Ride an arc in the markings with the left indicator on, without touching the lines.
strings.autodrom.A.2.how.0: Switch on the left direction indicator before the line marking the start of the exercise.
strings.autodrom.A.2.how.1: Reduce speed before entering the arc and keep it steady.
strings.autodrom.A.2.how.2: In the arc, look where you want to go (this is advice from the NYS Motorcycle Manual).
strings.autodrom.A.2.how.3: Switch off the indicator before the line marking the end of the exercise.
strings.autodrom.A.2.penalties.0: Touched the area with a foot - 100 points.
strings.autodrom.A.2.penalties.1: Ran a wheel over a control line - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.2.penalties.2: Crossed the line marking the start of the exercise with the left indicator off - 10 points.
strings.autodrom.A.2.tip: Your gaze steers the motorcycle: look at the exit of the arc, not at the line under your wheel.
strings.autodrom.A.3.name: Track board
strings.autodrom.A.3.goal: Ride along the narrow track board without running over the control lines or putting your feet down.
strings.autodrom.A.3.how.0: Approach the board in a straight line, having lined up the motorcycle in advance.
strings.autodrom.A.3.how.1: Keep a steady speed and do not brake hard on the board.
strings.autodrom.A.3.how.2: Look at the end of the board, not under the wheel.
strings.autodrom.A.3.penalties.0: Touched the area with a foot - 100 points.
strings.autodrom.A.3.penalties.1: Ran a wheel over a control line - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.3.tip: The main thing is a straight approach: correcting your direction on the board itself is almost impossible.
strings.autodrom.A.4.name: Gauge figure of eight
strings.autodrom.A.4.goal: Ride the figure of eight: first a circle to the right, then to the left, without touching the lines or the area.
strings.autodrom.A.4.how.0: Keep a low, steady speed and do not shut off the throttle.
strings.autodrom.A.4.how.1: Turn your head and look along the arc.
strings.autodrom.A.4.how.2: Follow the set path: first the right circle, then the left.
strings.autodrom.A.4.penalties.0: Touched the area with a foot - 100 points.
strings.autodrom.A.4.penalties.1: Ran a wheel over a control line - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.4.penalties.2: Deviated from the set path - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.4.tip: Practise the figure of eight on the driving school’s area until it becomes automatic: in the test it causes the most foot touchdowns.
strings.autodrom.A.5.name: Finish (motorcycle)
strings.autodrom.A.5.how.0: Switch on the right direction indicator before the finish line.
strings.autodrom.A.5.how.1: Cross the line and stop the motorcycle.
strings.autodrom.A.5.how.2: Under the method, you then select neutral, switch off the headlight and the engine, get off the motorcycle and put it on its stand.
strings.autodrom.A.5.penalties.0: Did not switch on the right indicator before the finish line - 10 points.
strings.autodrom.A.5.penalties.1: Exceeded the total time for the exercises set for the test ground - 100 points.
strings.autodrom.A.5.penalties.2: Did not complete an exercise or ran into an obstacle - 100 points.
strings.autodrom.A.5.penalties.3: Engine stalled during the exercises - 25 points.
strings.autodrom.A.5.tip: The right indicator at the finish is like the left one at the start: switch it on in advance.
strings.autodrom.E.0.name: How the test works for categories with a trailer
strings.autodrom.E.0.goal: Understand what is tested for BE, CE, C1E, DE and D1E and where to get the layout.
strings.autodrom.E.0.how.0: The practical test on a combination is taken separately from the base category and on a vehicle of the category for which the licence is issued ⟦101⟧.
strings.autodrom.E.0.how.1: The zones are marked under para. 39: control lines are marking 1.4, the start and end of exercises are a yellow broken line, “Start” and “Finish” are white strips 0.4 m wide, lettering is 1 m from the lines.
strings.autodrom.E.0.how.2: The list of exercises for combinations is not published in the Examination Rules. Find out the layout of your test ground from the specialised PSC or the training organisation.
strings.autodrom.E.0.penalties.0: We did not find exact penalties for combinations in open sources. As for other categories, the test ground system records wheels running over lines, the stopping place, direction indicators and time ⟦102⟧.
strings.autodrom.E.0.tip: Ask the training organisation to let you run through your test ground layout on the same kind of combination as the one used in the test.
strings.autodrom.E.1.name: Checking the combination before the start
strings.autodrom.E.1.goal: Make sure the trailer is coupled and in working order. Driving with a faulty coupling device is prohibited (para. 12(9) of the Rules).
strings.autodrom.E.1.how.0: The coupling device is locked and the ball is fully seated in the coupling head.
strings.autodrom.E.1.how.1: The safety cable is intact and attached to the towing vehicle.
strings.autodrom.E.1.how.2: The wiring connector is plugged in: the brake lights, direction indicators, reversing lights and position lamps of the trailer work.
strings.autodrom.E.1.how.3: The load is secured and evenly distributed, with heavy items over the axle.
strings.autodrom.E.1.how.4: The trailer’s parking brake is released, the jockey wheel is fully raised and the tyres are in good condition.
strings.autodrom.E.1.how.5: The exterior mirrors of the towing vehicle are set so that you can see the trailer.
strings.autodrom.E.1.penalties.0: This is not a test ground exercise but a checklist from a trailer manufacturer (Brenderup). A faulty coupling device and, in the dark, rear position lamps that are not lit prohibit driving (para. 12(9) of the Rules).
strings.autodrom.E.1.tip: A minute spent on the checklist costs less than a detached trailer.
strings.autodrom.E.2.name: Reversing with a trailer
strings.autodrom.E.2.goal: Steer the trailer when reversing and do not jackknife the combination.
strings.autodrom.E.2.how.0: Hold the steering wheel at the bottom: moving your hand to the right sends the trailer to the right, to the left - to the left.
strings.autodrom.E.2.how.1: Move slowly and give the trailer time to respond: the longer the trailer, the later it reacts.
strings.autodrom.E.2.how.2: Make small steering movements: the most common mistake is turning too sharply out of nervousness.
strings.autodrom.E.2.how.3: Watch both exterior mirrors and keep an eye on the front of the towing vehicle.
strings.autodrom.E.2.how.4: If the trailer has ended up at a sharp angle, drive forward, straighten the combination and start again.
strings.autodrom.E.2.penalties.0: A technique from the Brenderup manual. If your test ground has such an exercise, a wheel running over a control line is penalised; exact points for combinations are not published.
strings.autodrom.E.2.tip: The bottom of the steering wheel is the trailer’s “tail”: the trailer goes where you move your hand.
strings.notes.0: When you obtain a licence with several categories, the theory test is taken once and the practical test separately for each category; theory first, then practical ⟦103⟧.
strings.notes.1: The test contains 40 questions, each with several answers and one correct answer; the language is Kazakh, Russian or English ⟦104⟧.
strings.notes.2: Whether the set of questions depends on the category. Confirmed by the Examination Rules: one test of 40 questions for all categories being opened ⟦105⟧, and before the theory test starts the monitor shows the categories for which the exam is taken ⟦106⟧, that is, the system knows the category. Not officially confirmed: that questions are selected by category - the Examination Rules do not say so, and the question bank is not published. Indirect signs: commercial apps sell access to the bank by groups of categories (PDD24 in the App Store: “AA1B1”, “BBE”, “C1C”), and the kazpdd.kz blog (25.04.2026) writes that for B and BE “the ticket is generated by its own algorithm”. That is why on our site the questions are labelled by groups (cats), and general questions suit everyone.
strings.notes.3: Training at a training organisation is mandatory: candidates are admitted to the tests only after training at a driver training organisation, with a certificate of completing the course (Road Traffic Act, art. 74(1), as amended by Law No. 130-VIII of 03.10.2024, in force since 04.12.2024; para. 6 of the Examination Rules). The abolition of self-training for A, A1, B, B1 was announced back in April 2024 (Tengrinews, 23.04.2024).
strings.notes.4: Without a training organisation: a holder of a military personnel driving licence takes the test for the corresponding category without training at training organisations (Road Traffic Act, art. 74-1(5), added by Law No. 211-VIII of 16.07.2025, in force since 16.09.2025). From 17, people who have completed training on a referral from the local military administration bodies are admitted to the tests for B, C and C1; the licence is issued from 18 (art. 74(3)).
strings.notes.5: You do not need to obtain a category separately if it is already included in one you hold: A includes A1 and B1 (with a motorcycle-style seating position or motorcycle-type handlebars), B - A1 and B1 (since 05.04.2025), C - C1, D - D1, CE - C1E, DE - D1E (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(8)). We did not find any other way to open a category without training in the Act and the Rules.
strings.notes.6: Tengrinews (June 2026) writes that instead of a driving school you can study at a college or university in an automotive and tractor specialisation. The text of the Act and the Rules contains no such exception: a certificate from a driver training organisation is required. Check with the specialised PSC.
strings.notes.7: Age and experience under the current version of art. 74 (amended by Law No. 126-VIII of 18.07.2024, in force since 18.09.2024; checked against PRG, version of 25.08.2026, and kodeksy-kz, version of 30.07.2026): A1 - 16 years; A, B, B1, C1 - 18; C and D1 - 21 years and 3 years of experience as a driver, including 1 year on C1; Tm - 21 years; D and Tb - 23 years and 3 years of experience, including 1 year on D1; combinations (E) - after 12 months of holding the base category. The page kazpdd.kz/ru/rules/28 gives the old version (D, Tm, Tb - 25 years and 5 years of experience, including 3 years on D1), while kodeksy-kz retains the removed para. 4 on military personnel.
strings.notes.8: Article 74 has been supplemented with paras 2-1 and 2-2: persons held administratively liable under certain parts of arts 608 and 613 of the CAO are not allowed to obtain the right to drive for 7 years (Law No. 130-VIII, since 04.12.2024), for repeated such offences - 8 years; persons without the right to drive who were released from criminal liability for driving in a state of intoxication - 8 years (Law No. 326-VIII, since 25.08.2026).
strings.notes.9: A national driving licence is valid for 10 years (Road Traffic Act, art. 73(7)).
strings.notes.10: The practical test for Tm and Tb is taken at a training organisation ⟦107⟧, and for the other categories at the State Corporation’s automated test ground ⟦108⟧. For A and A1 and for combinations, the Examination Rules describe only the zone markings ⟦109⟧, and the list of exercises is set by the test ground method.
strings.notes.11: Retake: a repeat test is scheduled for the next working day; after two failed attempts at the theory or practical test, the next attempt is given no earlier than after one month; after three failed practical tests the theory result is annulled, and the theory test can be taken again no earlier than after two months ⟦110⟧. A passed theory test is valid for two years ⟦111⟧.
strings.notes.12: An inaccuracy in the Rules: para. 40 requires for the D1 practical test a bus with “not more than 28 seats and a length of not more than 7.0 m”, and for D “not less than 28 seats and not less than 7.0 m”. Under the Act, D1 means not more than 16 seats in addition to the driver’s seat (art. 73). Check with the specialised PSC which bus will be provided for the D1 test.
